About Helder

Healthcare Built on Trust


Helder Life Science Pvt. Ltd. is a quality-focused pharmaceutical organization committed to delivering reliable healthcare solutions and building long-term professional relationships.


We believe that healthcare is a responsibility. Our approach is guided by quality, transparency, trust, reliability, ethical practices, and continuous improvement.

Build Your Career. Make a Difference.

Grow with a team that supports you

Medical Representative (MR)

Key Responsibilities

  • Visit doctors, clinics, hospitals, and pharmacies.
  • Promote Helder Life Science products professionally.
  • Achieve assigned sales and business targets.
  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships.
  • Submit daily field activity and sales reports.
  • Develop business within assigned territories.

Who Can Apply?

  • Bachelor's Degree preferred.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to travel for field work.
  • Positive attitude and learning mindset.
  • Freshers are welcome.
  • Experienced professionals are encouraged to apply.
